FIELDS.NAME: Precision Plumbing & HVAC Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Precision Plumbing & HVAC Solutions specializes in residential and light commercial plumbing and HVAC services, including the installation, repair, and maintenance of boilers, furnaces, air conditioning units, and associated systems. Our operations are strictly limited to low- and medium-risk environments, avoiding high-risk job sites to minimize potential claims. We prioritize safety and regulatory compliance by adhering to local, state, and federal building codes and maintaining a strong safety program that includes regular employee training and equipment maintenance. Our technicians are fully licensed, ensuring their competency and compliance with industry standards. We do not engage in high-risk construction activities, demolition, or hazardous material handling, such as asbestos or lead paint abatement, so as to safeguard the well-being of our clients and staff. We also ensure that any subcontractors we work with carry appropriate insurance and are bound by indemnification agreements, further protecting our business and our clients during the execution of our services.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any demolition, blasting, or high-risk construction activities, nor does it conduct asbestos, lead paint abatement, or hazardous material handling. We confirm that all subcontractors maintain appropriate insurance and adhere to indemnification agreements. Additionally, we ensure regular, documented employee training and equipment maintenance to uphold our standards of safety and compliance.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Precision HVAC Services Inc., a small business focused on residential HVAC maintenance and repair, with no overlap in operations or risk exposure.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 08/10/2023, a minor water leak was detected in a residential property due to a corroded pipe fitting. The repair cost was $2,500, and the claim is currently closed as the customer was satisfied with the service provided.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM; Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and onsite watchpersons during off-hours for equipment protection.
